title: fix(plugin-detail, app-shell, components): the record page's controls are 44 px touch targets at phone width, and Back after 「‹」 leaves the record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLp3xCnQnby6kak4ePbSMRJ)_

Fixes #29071

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度（375 / 390 px）下，记录页自己的控件都达到 44 px 触控尺寸：记录标签和「+N」菜单、相关列表卡片的头部控件和行、放大视图的工具栏与分页、时间线筛选与「写备注」、评论工具栏、「显示 N 个空字段」、内联保存栏、底部操作栏、返回链接「‹」、上一条 / 下一条、复制记录 ID、附件上传、声明式操作按钮及其参数对话框的取消 / 确认。内联编辑铅笔（详情区和要点条）在触屏上始终显示。返回链接「‹」改为替换当前历史记录，浏览器「后退」不会再打开刚离开的记录。
- **为什么改**：移动端 App 用 WebView 承载 Console，手机用户看到的就是 375 / 390 px 的记录页。实测这些控件只有 16–40 px，铅笔要悬停才显示（触屏没有悬停，等于没有内联编辑入口），点「‹」后再按后退又回到记录。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改 `className` 字符串和一个 `<Link replace>`；`sm` 以上尺寸全部不变（e2e 用例在 1280 px 钉住 36 / 24 / 28 px 和悬停才显示的铅笔）。不加键、prop、导出或断点。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（`phoneBack` 的 `replace`）；`ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx`；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`；`ui/e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && npx playwright test e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts --project=chromium`（5 个用例通过）；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx`（含新的「后退不回到记录」用例）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。下方「Findings」列出不属于本卡的问题及其归属。

## What changes

The mobile app hosts the Console in a WebView, so a phone user gets the record page at 375 or 390 px. Driven there on six records, the page did not scroll sideways, its dialogs and menus fit the screen and the keyboard left the focused field in view, but most of the page's own controls were smaller than a finger, the inline-edit pencil was invisible on a touch screen, and the back link left the record behind it in the history.

- **44 px targets below `sm`**, through the spellings the code already uses for its phone faces (`h-11 sm:h-N`, `min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0`, `min-w-11 sm:min-w-0`):
  - `plugin-detail`: `RecordTabRow` (tabs and the `+N` trigger), `RelatedList` (card head, New / Add, rows and their name buttons, footer "View all", the enlarged view's filter, chips, New / Add / Export, sort and paging, Enlarge), `RelatedCardMenu` (⋯ and the reorder handle), `RelatedListEmptyFold` and `EmptySectionsFold` (the fold toggles and Expand), `DetailSection` (pencil, empty toggle, title row), `HeaderHighlight` (the strip's pencil), `InlineEditSaveBar` (Cancel / Save), `RecordActivityTimeline` ("Write a note…", the filter chips and select), `RichTextCommentInput` (the toolbar, which now wraps), `RecordTimelinePanel` (head), `record-reference-rail` (View All).
  - `app-shell`: `RecordDetailView` (the phone's 「‹」), `DeclaredActionsBar` (the declared decision buttons and the override menu trigger), `ActionParamDialog` (footer Cancel / Confirm), `RecordAttachmentsPanel` (Upload).
  - `components`: `record-top-bar` (↓ ↑ and the bar's other icon buttons; the bar grows from `h-10` to its content, `min-h-11`, so a 44 px control does not spill past its border), `containers.tsx` (the phone header bar's action buttons and ⋯), `RecordTitleChip` (copy record ID).
- **The inline-edit pencil** in the details body and in the header strip is drawn on a coarse pointer (`pointer-coarse:opacity-100`). With a mouse it still waits for hover or focus.
- **「‹」 replaces the record's history entry** (`<Link to={to} replace>`), so the browser's Back after it leaves for the entry below and never opens the record again. A page pushed from a parent record (a related row or a lookup) already went back with `navigate(-1)` and is unchanged.

No key, prop, export or breakpoint is added. `useIsMobile` / `usePhoneViewport` and the existing phone layouts are untouched.

## Run record

Six records, each at 375×812 and 390×844 (Chromium, `isMobile` + `hasTouch`), on the real Console (Vite source console against `examples/app-crm` and the showcase backend, signed in as the seeded admin):

| Record | Page |
| --- | --- |
| CRM lead | `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead/record/AsRu1Po-1-Fob7D-` |
| CRM account (151 contacts added) | `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_account/record/ZE2x6eRx2CNUIEf1` |
| CRM opportunity | `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity/record/MY5BwNPGtULohScT` |
| Showcase account | `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_account/record/2OeMEsWhxzpXuMYa` |
| Showcase project (line-item Tasks tab) | `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_project/record/9aZqRnYBQ6EY225w` |
| Approval request | `/apps/showcase_app/sys_approval_request/record/areq_214e57da-…` |

On each: load, every tab, the tab overflow menu, inline edit, the related New dialog, the related ⋯ menu, View all, Enlarge, a declared action's dialog, the action bar's ⋯ and the Edit action.

| Check | Before (base `0e43df23`), 375 and 390 | After (head), 375 and 390 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A. No horizontal page scroll | **Pass** on all 12. Only intentional inner scrollers: the project's Tasks line items (826 px in 275 / 290), the opportunity's product lines in Edit (548 in 341 / 356), the account's line items in New (1020 in 341 / 356). | **Pass** on all 12, same inner scrollers. |
| B. 44 px targets | **Fail.** Smaller-than-44 controls per page at 375 (same at 390): lead 38, account 72, opportunity 63, showcase account 68, project 43, approval 21. Mine: tabs 36 tall, `+N` 32×36; card ⋯ / New 24×24, reorder 20×24, card rows 18.8 tall; footer "View all" 20 tall; Enlarge 36; enlarged chips / Export 32; timeline chips 24, "Write a note…" 32; comment toolbar 28×28; "Show N empty fields" 28, Expand 16; Save / Cancel 36; action bar Edit 40, ⋯ 40×40; 「‹」 92×28 (seat), 69–153×28 measured; ↓ ↑ 28×28 (seat); copy ID 20×20; New 36; decision buttons 36 tall; param dialog Cancel / Confirm 40 tall; the pencil 20×20 at **opacity 0**. | **Pass for every control this card owns.** 「‹」 69.5×44, ↓ ↑ 44×44 in a 45 px bar, decision buttons and param Cancel / Confirm 44, pencil 44×44 at opacity 1 on all 12. Left (lead 14, account 28, opportunity 24, showcase account 35, project 25, approval 8): each is in Findings below. |
| C. Overlays inside the viewport | **Pass.** Dialogs fill `[0,0,W,H]`; the tab overflow, related ⋯ and action ⋯ menus sit inside; the declared action dialog `[0,92,375,720]`. | **Pass**, 40 overlay readings, all inside. |
| D. Keyboard (viewport shrunk by 336 px, focused field) | **Pass.** The focused field stays visible and uncovered; Save stays visible when there is one. | **Pass** (18 readings: visible, uncovered; Save visible in the 10 with a save bar). |
| E. 4× CPU, production build, account with 151 contacts | Title 1181 / 1035 ms, related cards 2733 / 2619 ms, scroll 61 / 60 fps with a 17 ms worst frame gap, worst interaction 200 / 176 ms, longest task 245 / 248 ms (one run). | A/B on the same box, interleaved, main's bundle against head's (only this PR's 19 source files differ): worst interaction main 320 / 256 / 256 / 176 ms, head 248 / 184 / 200 / 208 ms; longest task main 218–280, head 242–311; 60 fps and a 17 ms gap on both. Same envelope: the change costs nothing measurable. |

**Back after 「‹」** (seat input): from the lead list at 375 and 390, tap a row, step ↓ once, tap 「‹」, press the browser's Back. Before (the seat's reading): Back opened the record again. After: Back lands on the list (`/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead`), the record is not reopened; history length 2 → 3 (the row's push only; ↓ and 「‹」 each replace).

CPU throttling and the keyboard are measured here only, per the card. Screenshots of every step (before and after) are in the project folder, not on GitHub.

## Findings (not fixed here)

Each is measured in the after run and left to the card named.

- **Form widgets, 40 px and less** — select triggers, text / number inputs and lookup triggers 40 tall, lookup clear and Browse 40×40, date-picker clear and calendar 28×28, the percent slider thumb 24×24, the inline plain-text input 34 tall, the master-detail form's Create / Cancel 40, line-item cells 32 and their duplicate / remove 32×32, Add line 36, Receipt 28, the FileField Take photo 36. Seen in inline edit, the related New dialog and the project's Tasks tab. reach: #29072 (Forms).
- **Embedded grid's primary-field link, 22 px tall** — Activities tab rows ("Call", "Meeting"). reach: #29074 (Lists).
- **`DropdownMenuItem`, 32 px tall** — every menu on the page (tab overflow items, related ⋯ Hide, action ⋯ Refresh / Add to favorites / Share / Delete). The cause is the shared primitive `ui/dropdown-menu.tsx`, used app-wide. reach: cross-flow, the menu primitive (the parent #29040 to place).
- **Radix `Tabs` on an authored page, 38 px tall** — the project's and the approval request's Details / Tasks / Related / Timeline tabs come from `ui/tabs.tsx`, not `RecordTabRow`. reach: shared primitive (the parent #29040 to place).
- **Field value links** — a lookup value ("Dev Admin") 16 tall, a URL value 20 tall, in the highlight strip and the details body. They sit inline in text, so a 44 px box would break the line. reach: the fields renderers (#29072 Forms reads them too).
- **The dialog close ✕, 16×16** — `dialog.tsx`; per the seat, not this card.
- **`managed-by-badge`, 119.6×18** — a tooltip chip on the approval request, not a control. Note only.
- **Sheet primitive** — no record-flow failure traced to `sheet.tsx` (#29078).
- **Back on a page opened from a list.** 「‹」 now replaces, so the history keeps one copy of the list (`[list, list]` instead of `[list, record, list]`): Back after 「‹」 shows the list the reader is already on. A clean pop needs the list's row navigation to mark its push as the related rows do (`recordPagePushState`), which is in `ObjectView.tsx` / `record-list-face.tsx` (#28915's files, landed in #29108). reach: #29074 (Lists, the row navigation). The drawer has no phone face (a phone opens no drawer; #29108 made it the desktop default), so there is no drawer Back to fix at phone width.
- **4× CPU, opening the 151-row Contacts tab** — the click handler takes 176–392 ms on main and head alike, at or over the 200 ms INP line. reach: #29074 (Lists, the embedded grid's render).

## Tests

- `ui/e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts` (new, Chromium): reads each control's class string from its source file, compiles Tailwind, and lays out a transcription of the record page (top bar with 「‹」 and ↓ ↑, tabs and `+N`, a section field with its pencil, the strip pencil, a related card head, menu, handle and rows, the comment toolbar, the save bar, the action bar). At 375×812 and 390×844 with touch: every control is at least 44×44, ends inside the viewport and is drawn at opacity 1; the page is no wider than the viewport; the top bar is at least 45 px. The mobile dialog fills the viewport and its close is 44 px. At 1280 with a mouse: a tab is 36, the card ⋯ 24, Save 36, ↓ 28, the strip pencil 20, and both pencils are at opacity 0. 5 passed.
- `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx`: a new case, "「‹」 does not leave the record behind it in the history" (home → list → record, tap 「‹」, Back lands on the list with no record, Back again reaches home).

## Acceptance notes

- From `sm` up every control keeps its size; a mouse still reveals the pencil on hover (pinned in the spec at 1280).
- The approval panel is #29070's and is not touched. Shared chrome (AppShell, ConsoleLayout, UnifiedSidebar, app switcher, nav groups) is not touched; no shared-chrome cause was found in the record flow.
- Files outside the claim's declared surface (app-shell views, plugin-detail): `components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx`, `components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx`, `components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`. Each is the record header's own control (the top bar, the copy-ID chip, the phone header's action bar), changed in class strings only, so no exported type moves and Clause-② stays no.
- None of the files the card excludes is touched (`navigation-overlay.tsx`, `record-list-face.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `recordOpenPreference.ts` — #29108 changed them on main and merged in cleanly — `ui/packages/mobile/**`, the console's `main` / `App` / `AppContent.tsx`, `sheet.tsx`, `dialog.tsx`).
- Diff against main: 22 files, 404 insertions, 66 deletions.
